name: MonarchTabs
title: Tabs
summary: Line tabs with an accent underline under the selected tab, counts, and a row that scrolls when the labels do not fit.
whenToUse: To switch between views of related content in the same place: the sections of a record, filtered lists with counts.
whenNotToUse: For the top-level destinations of an app use a NavigationBar or NavigationRail (see top-nav). For two to four short, equal views use MonarchSegmentedControl. For choices that filter without changing the view use a chip.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTabs(selectedIndex: Int, onSelectedIndexChange: (Int) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, panel: (@Composable (selectedIndex: Int) -> Unit)? = null, tabs: MonarchTabsScope.() -> Unit)

interface MonarchTabsScope { fun tab(text: String, enabled: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, count: String? = null, countTone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, contentDescription: String? = null) }

options.name: selectedIndex
options.description: The index of the selected tab; the underline is drawn under it. State is hoisted.

options.name: onSelectedIndexChange
options.description: Called with the index of the tab the user chooses.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the tabs and their panel.

options.name: panel
options.description: The content of the selected tab, drawn under the row with a 16dp gap. Null when the caller lays out the content.

options.name: tabs
options.description: Declares the tabs with tab(text, enabled, icon, count, countTone, contentDescription).

states.name: selected
states.description: The label in the default text color with a 2dp strong accent underline; the label is not tinted.

states.name: unselected
states.description: The label in the muted text color; the default color when hovered.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The label in the disabled color; the tab cannot be chosen.

states.name: with a count
states.description: A small pill with the count follows the label, neutral or in a status tone.

states.name: scrolling
states.description: When the labels do not fit the row scrolls sideways and brings the selected tab into view.

appearance: The label is 14sp medium: default color when selected, muted otherwise. The selected tab has a 2dp underline in the strong accent role with round top corners over a 1dp divider in the default border role. In the high-contrast themes the same roles resolve to stronger colors.
platformNotes: Built from its own layers, not the Material 3 tab rows. A tab is 36dp high with 12dp of touch area above it, so the 48dp target is met and the underline stays against the divider. The web's pill variant is the segmented control; the web's link tabs are navigation and are not offered.
accessibility: Each tab has the tab role, the selected state and its position (2 of 4); the label and the count are read together.
Each tab is at least 48dp high and wide.
A disabled tab is announced as disabled and does not respond.
The selection is marked by the underline and the text color, and announced as selected.
With a keyboard or D-pad the arrow keys move between tabs; Enter or Space chooses one.
The order of the tabs follows the layout direction.
edgeCases: A tab never wraps its label: the row scrolls instead, also at the largest font size.
A count is read as part of the name unless contentDescription is set; keep it a number.
